correctness.rationale: PASS: For an extensive injective partial map, f^2=f iff f is a partial identity. Commutation of f with e_B is equivalent to B being invariant across every strict arrow i->f(i); the increasing partial-injection graph is disjoint directed paths, with n-r(f) components and c_E(f)=2^(n-r(f)). Rank-r strict injections enumerate by ballot/reflection as Narayana 1/m binom(m,r)binom(m,r+1), and fixed-point gap insertion gives S=1+zS(1-u+uS), F=S/(1-zS). Hence all k-fold idempotent tuple counts equal 2^(kn)F_n(2^-k). Analytic positive root z=(1-u)/(2-u) enters the physical sheet iff u<(3-sqrt5)/2, and meets the branch singularity at equality; standard transfer produces three stated asymptotic regimes. Independent n<=5 direct element enumeration+commutation and F4 checks passed; this does not alone prove the asymptotic.
residual_risks: Counts relative idempotent centralizers, not all-element centralizers; k fixed as n grows.
